seo.title: Websites for businesses in Monterrey
seo.description: All-inclusive websites for coffee shops, clinics and musicians in Monterrey: domain, hosting, changes and support from $499 MXN + VAT a month.

hero.title: One clear price for your Monterrey website
hero.lead: Start with the base plan, add the pack for your type of business, and pick only the extras you need.

base.lead: Everything a local business needs to show up on Google.
base.otherNiche: Don't see your business? The base plan works for any local business.

pack.lead: Everything in Web Presence, plus what your type of business needs.
pack.toSummaryExtras: See my plan summary and extras ({count})

features.domain: Domain in your name, hosting and the security padlock (https)
features.orders: WhatsApp orders with a pre-filled message
features.delivery: Rappi, Uber Eats and DiDi Food links
features.appointments: Appointments by WhatsApp or a booking platform
features.inquiries: WhatsApp inquiries for events or lessons

delivery.title: Ready in 14 business days
delivery.text: Counted from when I get your logo, photos and details. I write and polish the copy.

changes.title: 2 changes a month
changes.text: Send them over WhatsApp and they are done within 5 business days.

domain.title: Your domain is yours
domain.text: In your name from day one, and still yours if you cancel.

payment.title: Ways to pay
payment.text: Bank transfer (SPEI) or automatic charge, always with a CFDI invoice.

delivery.q: How long until my site is ready?
delivery.a: Up to 14 business days, counted from when I have all your content.

content.q: What do I need to send you?
content.a: Your logo, photos and basic details: services, prices, hours and location. I write and polish the copy from there.

change.a: A single request, like updating prices, swapping a section's photos or adjusting hours. A new section is quoted as an extra page.

google.q: Will I rank first on Google?
google.a: I set your site up so Google can find it and connect it to your Google Business Profile, but nobody can guarantee a specific spot in the results.
